snippet.title: SLASHBANG SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Slashbang is rearing to go at the Sonic Amateur Game Expo! Try it out, with an expo EXCLUSIVE build with a new customization option and environmental details!

TRY IT HERE! - https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/slashbang.2563

Itch.io - https://powerupt.itch.io/slashbang-vertical-slice
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/powerupt.bsky.social

Enter Slashbang! A movement shooter with an extreme emphasis on running!

Gameplay is closer to a 50/50 split of movement to combat than other movement shooters. Use an array of movement abilities to speed through levels, like drifting, running up walls, and grinding on rails. It's an FPS spliced with Adventure era Sonic DNA primarily, but it's so much more past that!

Combat is primarily done with a pistol and David's Spector Flynn's claws. Shoot fascist invaders in the head to make it pop like a watermelon, and you can also slice enemies to gory bits! All of this is generated on the fly, it's possible to slice the arms and legs off of enemies, or just shred them  so their mothers won't recognize them. Props in the level are also fully destructible, and there may even be secrets contained within.

This vertical slice (get it?) is free, and contains one level with a boss, and some fully animated and voice acted cutscenes. It's repayable, and you can compete for best times with your friends. Have none? Awwww. Well that's okay, since you can compete on the Maskii Productions Discord server instead! You can also try for S ranks, which have strict requirements on what you must do in a level before reaching the end, like collecting 5 USB drives, and killing an enemy every 30 seconds.

With a style reminiscent of Jet Set Radio, Slashbang aims to bring some style and substance to the comedic carnage. Get it now on Itch.io!
